questions.q: Which type of research is used to understand WHY users behave a certain way, and typically needs only 5-8 people to find patterns?
A teammate builds a persona that's just "Alex, 25, likes video games." What is it missing to actually be useful?
options: Real Goals and Pain Points sourced from actual research

questions.q: In an Empathy Map, which quadrant captures a user's internal monologue -- what they're privately thinking but not necessarily saying out loud?
Why does a wireframe deliberately leave out color, fonts, and real images?
options: To save time since color is added automatically later
So the conversation stays focused on layout and priority instead of visual style
Because wireframing tools can't display color
Colors are added only after the site is coded

questions.q: Why is it risky to wireframe only the desktop version of a page and assume mobile will "just work"?
options: A layout doesn't automatically resize usably -- a multi-column layout can become cramped or unreadable on a phone
Desktop wireframes are always approved first by clients
It isn't risky, mobile always adjusts automatically

questions.q: If a sitemap is just a flat list of every page with no grouping, what does the chapter say is actually wrong with it?
options: Nothing -- flat sitemaps are the professional standard
It needs more structure -- a real site should summarize into about 5-7 clear top-level nav categories
It should be converted into a wireframe instead

questions.q: "Our site loads slowly" and "a bigger competitor might launch a leaderboard feature next month" -- which SWOT categories do these belong to, respectively?
"As a user, I want a dark mode" is missing the piece that makes it a real User Story. What's missing?
options: The "so that" goal explaining why they want it

questions.q: In the MoSCoW method, what does it mean if every single feature on the list ends up labeled "Must Have"?
options: The method has failed -- the whole point is forcing real trade-offs
It means the project is ahead of schedule
It means more features should be added
